title: Missing-underlay negative path (harness refusal exit + app street-skeleton fallback) has no test — the fonts precedent (CI gate 13) was not followed
detail: Both new failure behaviours — the harness refusal (run.odin, dublin_shot.odin return-2) and the app's degraded street-skeleton draw — are never driven by any test or CI gate. Only the happy path (asset present) runs.
recommended_fix: Add tools/underlay_guard_check.sh mirroring font_guard_check.sh: copy assets minus maps/dublin_underlay.png, run `harness run dublin_board`, assert the refusal/exit; wire it into tools/ci-local.sh GATES.

title: dublin_node_street / seg-grid geometry and the axis-aligned fallback branch have zero unit tests — only T2 visual coverage at default camera
detail: The approved node grammar's core math is pinned only by pixel goldens. No unit test covers the ±1-cell window vs DUBLIN_SEG_MAX_DIST=3.0 boundary (a straight segment 2.9 tiles away in an unscanned cell yields found=false) or the fallback branch.
recommended_fix: Add app/render/dublin_test.odin: build a tiny Map_Board, pin dublin_node_street hits (on-street, near-street, window-edge, exactly-3.0, no-street fallback) per the camera_test/wire_path_test precedent.

title: osm_extract.py's ~200 lines of new determinism-critical geometry (build_sea, connect_roads, chaikin_*, build_street_blocks) have no unit tests and --verify runs in no CI gate
evidence:
tools/osm_extract.py:452-454 (build_sea docstring):
    Deterministic: pure shapely ops on the pinned raw input (the same
    cached raw re-bakes byte-identical — verified by --verify).
grep counts in the worktree: `grep -c osm_extract .github/workflows/ci.yml tools/ci-local.sh` → ".github/workflows/ci.yml:0", "tools/ci-local.sh:0". Sibling precedent exists: tools/test_sprite_foldin.py, tools/test_sprite_order.py (unit-tested Python tools).
detail: The briefing's hard rule 2 (re-extract, determinism preserved) rests on a manual-only --verify flag. The new pure functions (sea-face partition, road stitching, STRtree nearest-segment snap) have no automated determinism or correctness tests.
recommended_fix: Add tools/test_osm_extract.py unit-pinning build_sea/connect_roads/chaikin/build_street_blocks on small fixture inputs (per test_sprite_* precedent), and run `osm_extract.py --verify` in ci-local.sh when .osm-cache is present.

title: Committed underlay PNG's byte-stability claim (tEXt/iTXt/zTXt strip) is unverified — no re-render determinism check for the Blender bake
evidence:
tools/blender_board/blender_board_build.py:484-493:
# strip Blender's wall-clock tEXt chunks — the committed asset must be
# byte-stable across re-renders (the 2026-08-23 field note)
...
    if _ct not in (b"tEXt", b"iTXt", b"zTXt"):
        _out += _png[_i:_i+12+_ln]
print(f"stripped timestamp chunks: {len(_png)} -> {len(_out)} bytes")
detail: The PR claims a byte-stable committed asset, but nothing verifies a re-render reproduces the committed PNG (or even that the strip output is stable). The shipped look is golden-covered; the pipeline claim is not.
recommended_fix: Add a verify step (two bakes → byte-compare, or committed-PNG chunk-scan assertion) to the blender_board pipeline, mirroring osm_extract's --verify pattern.

title: Zoomed-crop rendering has no automated regression surface — dublin goldens are default-camera only; the 3.2x crop lives solely in the manual dublin-shot verb
evidence:
demos/dublin_board.dem tail:
capture at 30000ms
capture at 90000ms
(no zoom/camera commands in the demo; `grep -n zoom demos/dublin_board.dem` matches only the comment line 11). goldens/dublin_board/ contains only 30000ms.png + 90000ms.png. harness/dublin_shot.odin header: "Usage: harness dublin-shot [outdir]" renders baywide.png + templebar.png (zoom 3.2) — but grep of tools/ci-local.sh GATES shows no dublin-shot gate.
detail: Briefing hard rule 5 requires the style to hold at a zoomed crop, yet nothing automated pins the zoomed render; a zoom-path regression (e.g. in DrawTexturePro/dublin_screen_tile) would pass all 13 CI gates.
recommended_fix: Either add a `capture at ... zoom` capability + golden to the dublin demo, or promote a headless dublin-shot capture diff into tools/ci-local.sh.
